MOD = 1000000007

def mod_pow(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        print(mod_pow(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(mod_pow(p, p))
        return
    a = k
    order = 1
    while a != 1:
        a = (a * k) % p
        order += 1
    print(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) // order))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
